source_title: Is Etsy Still Worth It In 2026
snippet_primary: "Here is where I get honest in a way that a lot of content creators do not. My revenue went down. In 2024, I did $135,000 in revenue from my Etsy print on demand shop. In 2025, that number dropped to $109,000. My profit margin is around 45%. And yes, I know that is still a lot of money, and I know that some people reading this would be absolutely thrilled with $49,050 profit from a side business they run from their laptop."
subject_exact: Etsy print-on-demand seller reports revenue decline from $135,000 (2024) to $109,000 (2025) with 45% profit margin yielding approximately $49,050 net profit in 2025
metric_unit: USD annual revenue from Etsy print-on-demand shop in 2025 (down from $135,000 in 2024)
